metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened GIMP Windows menu and clicked Hide Docks in 3 turns (score=1.0). Screenshot 1 shows Single-Window Mode is checked (active) in the Windows menu.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Windows menu to toggle GIMP display and window-mode settings
metadata.explanation: Screenshot 1 shows Single-Window Mode is active (checkmark visible in Windows menu). The Windows menu has a Single-Window Mode toggle just below Hide Docks. This task chains the same Windows-menu navigation skill. Evaluator reads sessionrc after GIMP quits and checks single-window-mode is disabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/sessionrc, which is the authoritative file for GIMP's single-window mode setting.
Postconfig correctly quits GIMP with ctrl+q before the getter runs, ensuring GIMP has flushed its session state to sessionrc.
Metric correctly checks single_window_mode == 'no', which matches the instruction's requirement to turn OFF single-window mode.
Expected value {'single_window_mode': 'no'} is semantically correct for the task instruction.
Metric accesses expected.get('single_window_mode') directly, which is correct for type='rule' (framework passes the rules dict as expected).
Edge case where the key is absent (unknown) is treated as disabled, which is correct since GIMP may omit default/off settings from sessionrc.
Parsing logic (lstrip '(', rstrip ')\n', split) correctly handles GIMP's sessionrc line format '(single-window-mode yes/no)'.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing the postconfig sleep from 1 second to 2-3 seconds to ensure GIMP has fully written sessionrc on slower systems before the getter reads the file.
